description: ONLY when the user asks for a specific prompt. Returns the rules and card material for writing ONE generation prompt for a saved character — concept, illustration, voice, video, song or theme. Write it, then call character_prompt_save. Prompts only; no generator is called. Never run this as part of creating a character.

kind.description: concept = A-pose sheet · illustration = key-art scene · voice = TTS voice design · video = image-to-video clip (Kling, Veo and similar) · song = Suno · theme = instrumental leitmotif (ElevenLabs Music composition plan)

name: character_prompt
title: Generation prompt brief (on request)
